Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

hello — a greeting when you meet someone. Example: Hello, I'm Ana.
hi — a friendly, informal greeting. Example: Hi, Tom!
goodbye — a word you say when you leave. Example: Goodbye, see you tomorrow.
teacher — a person who helps students learn. Example: She is my English teacher.
student — a person who studies at a school or class. Example: I am a student.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Good morning!
• Good afternoon!
• My name is...
• Nice to meet you.
• See you later.
Vocabulary practice: choose the correct word.

hello /heˈləʊ/ — hi /haɪ/
Listen and repeat three times.

Grammar focus: Subject pronouns, verb 'be' affirmative.
Use I am, you are, he is, she is, it is, we are, they are. In speech we shorten them: I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're. Example: I am a student. She is a teacher.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Complete: She ___ a teacher.
Which sentence is correct?
Complete the sentence.
Reading (Reading classroom instructions and greetings):
Hello! My name is Marta. I am a student. This is Mr Brown. He is a teacher. Goodbye!
Who is Mr Brown?
Listening (Short dialogue of people meeting for first time):
A: Hello! B: Hi! A: My name is Ana. B: Nice to meet you, Ana. A: Goodbye! B: See you later!
What is the woman's name?
Speaking: Greeting and self-introductions in class

• My name is...
